stories.headline: Deno 3.0 Ships With Native npm Compatibility and Zero-Config Deploy
stories.excerpt: The Deno runtime's third major release drops the last barriers to npm ecosystem access, running most Node.js packages without configuration. A built-in deploy command pushes to Deno Deploy with a single CLI invocation, targeting serverless edge workloads.

stories.headline: HTTP/3 Now Serves 35 Percent of Global Web Traffic, Cloudflare Reports
stories.excerpt: The QUIC-based protocol has crossed a third of all web requests measured by Cloudflare's network, with mobile browsers driving adoption fastest. Performance gains of 10–30 percent on high-latency connections are cited as the main driver.

stories.headline: Brain Organoids Develop Spontaneous Neural Oscillations Matching Infant EEG Patterns
stories.excerpt: Lab-grown brain organoids cultured for 10 months now produce electrical activity patterns statistically indistinguishable from premature infant brainwaves. The finding intensifies ethical debates while opening new avenues for studying neurodevelopmental disorders.
stories.licenceBasis: ScienceDaily release summary with attribution and link-out

stories.headline: U.S. Yield Curve Uninverts for First Time in 26 Months, Signaling Policy Shift
stories.excerpt: The spread between 2-year and 10-year Treasury yields turned positive this week for the first time since June 2024. Historically, the uninversion — not the initial inversion — has more closely preceded economic downturns, though the signal is noisy.

stories.headline: Amazon Deforestation Falls to 15-Year Low Under Expanded Satellite Enforcement
stories.excerpt: Brazil's INPE space agency reports that forest clearance in the Amazon fell 48 percent year-over-year, the lowest August figure since 2011. Analysts credit real-time satellite alerts that trigger rapid enforcement responses, though illegal mining remains a challenge.

stories.headline: NIST Finalizes Post-Quantum Cryptography Standards After Eight-Year Process
stories.excerpt: Three algorithms — ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA — are now official federal standards for quantum-resistant encryption and digital signatures. NIST urges organizations to begin migration planning immediately, estimating full transitions will take 5–10 years.

stories.headline: Europa Clipper Enters Jupiter Orbit, Begins Ice Shell Survey
stories.excerpt: NASA's Europa Clipper spacecraft completed its Jupiter orbit insertion burn and transmitted its first close-range images of Europa's fractured ice surface. The mission will make 49 close flybys over three years to characterize the moon's subsurface ocean.

stories.headline: Offshore Wind Installations Hit Record Quarter as Floating Turbines Scale Up
stories.excerpt: Global offshore wind capacity added 8.2 gigawatts in Q2 2026, a single-quarter record. Floating foundation deployments — turbines anchored in deep water rather than fixed to the seabed — accounted for 12 percent of new capacity, up from 2 percent two years ago.
stories.licenceBasis: AI-synthesized from multiple public sources — not independently verified

stories.headline: Even 11 Minutes of Daily Walking Cuts All-Cause Mortality by 23 Percent, Meta-Analysis Confirms
stories.excerpt: A meta-analysis pooling data from 196 studies and 30 million participant-years found that modest physical activity — as little as 75 minutes per week of brisk walking — was associated with substantial mortality reduction. Benefits plateaued around 300 minutes weekly.
stories.licenceBasis: PubMed abstract — public access per NLM terms

stories.headline: New Benchmark Shows Leading Models Still Hallucinate on 8 Percent of Factual Questions
stories.excerpt: A consortium of universities released a 10,000-question factual accuracy benchmark and tested seven frontier models. Even the best performer fabricated answers 8.1 percent of the time, with medical and legal domains showing the highest error rates.

stories.headline: TSMC Arizona Fab Produces First Commercial 3nm Chips on American Soil
stories.excerpt: TSMC's Phoenix facility shipped its first batch of 3-nanometer processors, marking the most advanced semiconductor manufacturing ever done in the United States. Apple is reportedly the launch customer, with AMD and Nvidia in the production queue.

stories.headline: Artificial Photosynthesis System Converts CO₂ to Ethanol at 18 Percent Efficiency
stories.excerpt: Researchers demonstrated a copper-based catalyst paired with a perovskite solar cell that converts carbon dioxide and water into ethanol with record efficiency. The system operates under ambient conditions, though durability beyond 200 hours remains unproven.
